messages.subject: [unmarked] Species richness models are available in "unmarked"?
parts:
Hi all.

I´m a recent user of "unmarked" and I have a very quick question: Species richness models are available in "unmarked"? In particular I want to know if model in (Dorazio  & Royle, 2005) is available in the package.

The paper title is: Estimating Size and Composition of Biological Communities by Modeling the Occurrence of Species

Im not really clear if this model is a particular case of the current implemented models in "unmarked". I suppose that the function "multinomPois" is the implemented model, but Im not really sure if this function just apply to model abundance or it can apply also for modeling richness.

Thanks for your help.

Emmanuel.
